t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on mockup of a warm limestone paper drawing sheet inside a fine navy border. Left: a large light-weight navy sans headline in sentence case with a light one-line subhead, surrounded by generous empty space. Centre: a faint pale grey hairline schematic of boxes, lines and small table grids, with one small steel-blue element. Right: a vertical hairline and a narrow column of numbered mono notes for <CONTENT>. Bottom-right: a small title block with grid cells. Flat line art, no shading, square corners, calm.
signature_idea: The news index becomes the numbered notes column of a drawing sheet, with each note a link into the page that applies it.
strengths: notes column is a natural, ownable way to list articles
mono notes and light headline match the brand
weaknesses: background schematic is meaningless filler and looks unfinished
title block is mostly empty cells
notes column is cramped against the right edge while the left is empty
notes have no dates or tags, so it reads as a list not a register
brand_fit_why: Limestone sheet, navy border, light headline, mono notes and one accent fit well, but the schematic is filler and the layout is lopsided.
